name: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS
description: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS is Google’s text-to-speech model for expressive voice generation and custom character design across more than 100 languages. It creates original voices from natural language prompts and offers granular control over acting cues, pacing, accents, and conversational reactions. Long-form audio and native two-speaker dialogue make it well suited to immersive audiobooks, games, podcasts, and interactive media
